name: Manufact

business_model.summary: Manufact is a cloud platform for deploying, testing, observing, and publishing MCP servers and apps, which developers pay for via subscription and usage-based pricing.

evidence.quote: We have usage-based pricing and on our free account we give free credits for you to try it out.
The Free plan is $0 and includes $5/month in usage credits. Hobby is $25/month and adds preview deployments

team.summary: The company was cofounded by Pietro and Luigi, who have been working on MCP since April 2025 and previously built the open-source mcp-use SDKs.

evidence.quote: we are Pietro and Luigi, cofounders of Manufact
We have been working on MCP since April 2025.

product.summary: Manufact provides hosting, cross-client testing, publishing checks, a submission pack, a cloud inspector, and analytics for MCP servers and apps.

evidence.quote: Manufact (formerly mcp-use) is a platform for deploying, testing, observing, and publishing MCP servers and MCP apps.

size_hint.summary: The market is growing rapidly as major tech companies adopt MCP, with some reporting that over 15% of their usage already comes from their MCP servers.

evidence.quote: All major tech companies have an MCP server, and many of those are reporting that already 15+% of their usage comes from their MCP

competitors.summary: Competitors and alternatives mentioned include Skybridge (a TypeScript framework for MCP), Stainless (which users are migrating off of), and general hosting platforms like Vercel.

evidence.quote: You may want to have a look at Skybridge, a TypeScript framework designed to build MCP servers and MCP Apps
evidence.author: harijoe

evidence.quote: i'm migrating off stainless after anthropic bought them, we have to be off by september
evidence.author: ICodeSometimes

evidence.quote: I have an MCP server that is working well with Auth (Google Only), running on vercel. What benefit would I get from running it on manufact?
evidence.author: mrtimo

why_now.summary: MCP is reaching a maturity milestone as major clients open marketplaces for one-click installation and dynamically present MCP servers based on user intent.

evidence.quote: We feel that MCP is reaching its maturity moment. Now that MCPs are starting to be easy to install and discover
Clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) are starting to dynamically present MCP servers/apps to users, based on their intent.

risks.risk: Skepticism regarding the longevity and necessity of MCP, with some developers viewing it as a dead end or a simple protocol that doesn't require dedicated hosting.

evidence.quote: MCP is a deadend. CLI use is the future.
evidence.author: sampton

evidence.quote: MCP is a protocol, that's all.
evidence.author: saberience

risks.risk: Friction in user onboarding due to forced signups and unclear pricing structures.

evidence.quote: Having to sign up to browse available MCPs stopped me dead in my tracks and made me close the tab.
evidence.author: Brainspackle

evidence.quote: One thing that's stopping me, what does credits mean on your pricing page?
evidence.author: msencenb

risks.risk: Credibility issues stemming from misleading testimonials on their website, such as quoting their own CTO under a section for external dev teams.

evidence.quote: On your website under "Thousands of dev-teams are building with mcp-use" you include a quote from your CTO (@enri).
evidence.author: zxela

founder_depth.why: The founders have been working on MCP since its early days in April 2025 and created the highly popular open-source mcp-use SDKs, which have millions of downloads.

evidence.quote: We have been working on MCP since April 2025.
10M+ SDK downloads across Python and TypeScript.

shipping_evidence.why: The product is fully live with extensive features, detailed documentation, open-source SDKs, and a clear pricing structure.

evidence.quote: You can try out https://manufact.com for free today.
The Free plan is $0 and includes $5/month in usage credits.

demand_signal.why: There is strong engagement on Hacker News, with multiple active users confirming they have been using the product for months, though some commenters remain skeptical of MCP itself.

evidence.quote: we've been using manufact for months now. couldn't build mcps another way.
evidence.author: sebastiancrossa

evidence.quote: Love it guys! Also working deep in the MCP space we’ve used manufact right since the start.
evidence.author: elliotgarreffa

defensibility.why: They have a strong brand and integration depth through their open-source SDKs, but face potential competition from general-purpose hosting platforms like Vercel, and some developers argue MCP is too simple to require a dedicated cloud.

evidence.quote: I have an MCP server that is working well with Auth (Google Only), running on vercel. What benefit would I get from running it on manufact?
evidence.author: mrtimo

evidence.quote: MCP is a protocol, that's all.
evidence.author: saberience

analysis.case_summary: The strongest point is the founders' deep domain expertise and massive open-source traction with mcp-use, while the weakest point is the risk that MCP is just a simple protocol that developers will choose to host on general-purpose platforms like Vercel.
would_change_my_mind: If major AI clients like Claude or ChatGPT deprecate or move away from the MCP standard.
If general-purpose hosting platforms like Vercel introduce native, seamless MCP testing and deployment features that match Manufact's workflow.
If the open-source mcp-use SDK downloads and GitHub stars stop growing, indicating a decline in developer interest.
data_gaps: Actual revenue figures or paid subscriber counts for the Manufact cloud platform.
The exact conversion rate from free/open-source mcp-use SDK users to paid Manufact cloud customers.
The specific apps currently live on the OpenAI or Claude stores that are hosted on Manufact.
